asset.name: Please acknowledge a policy
asset.description: Sent to each person the first time a policy version is issued to them.
asset.subject: Action needed: read and acknowledge the {{policy_title}} (v{{version}})
asset.html_body:
Please read the {{policy_title}}

Hi {{staff_name}},

Version {{version}} of the {{policy_title}} applies from {{effective_date}}. {{policy_summary}}

Read the policy

Once you have read it, reply to this email with "I have read and understood the {{policy_title}}" by {{due_date}}.

Sent by the policy acknowledgement tracker
